## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY showing short-term fear pick-up while Credit Spread (proxy: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION) signals rising credit stress; SPY/TLT flat with SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION supports mixed stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION, consistent with Credit Spread ↑ rising. Fear dynamics mixed: VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY (VIX 1W: +2.24% ↑ rising) while Stocks vs Bonds flat: SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tightening: Dollar Strength ↑ rising (ratio) with Duration Preference ABOVE TREND and Yield Curve ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.30% → flat), while TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION shows limited bond respite.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and industrials leading: XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND and XAR (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +25.78%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging in CORRECTION with XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US in mild pullback: SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION while EM outperformance pockets persist with EEM (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +9.23%) ABOVE TREND and China mixed with FXI (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +3.53%) CORRECTION.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation remains functional: IBIT (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND show risk-on pockets, while Speculation Index is in CORRECTION (ratio), signaling selective risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals mixed with CPER (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +9.27%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +9.71%) ABOVE TREND, while NatGas UNG (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
MAJOR DIVERGENCE: SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION show 1W vs 1M mismatches limiting conviction; confirmed pockets include IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposure via XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to tech risk given XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION and communication risk via XLC (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -0.95%) BELOW TREND, while bonds/TLT remain a neutral hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND if commodity strength persists. BEARISH: Tech XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION and Communication XLC (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -0.95%) BELOW TREND on momentum fade.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND and Uranium URA (1W: +8.13% | 1M: +28.75%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) BELOW TREND and select agri like CORN (1W: -3.97% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (short-term complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health trigger), SLV breakouts above current run to sustain (monitor SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND), XLK/XLV relative cross near prior pivot for tech risk signals.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from rising VXX and creeping credit stress. Energy and precious metals showing strength (XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND; SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND) while major divergence across SPY, XLK and TLT is the key risk to monitor.
